headings.t: Affordable & reliable EV truck charging at your destination

sections.text:
9:41
Affordable & reliable EV truck charging at your destination
ChargeNet is the platform for location owners & carrier managers to collaborate on decarbonisation of road logistics by sharing charging infrastructure at destination.
With ChargeNet you can charge at the right price, at the right place, at the right time.
Explore Use Cases
Contact Us

images.alt: EV truck charging with CCS2 connector

sections.text:
What ChargeNet does for You
We bring locations with charging infrastructure and EV fleets together on one platform.
Location Managers
Monetize your charging infrastructure efficiently
Key Benefits
→
Make private charging infrastructure accessible: Give limited access to your private charging infrastructure to your partners
→
Access Control: Secure authentication and authorization for different user groups
→
Pricing proposals for frequent visitors: Contractual pricing agreements for even better prices per kWh against a fixed minimum capacity
→
Automated Billing: Seamless payment processing and invoice generation
Platform Features
Location Dashboard
Access Management
Revenue Tracking
Pricing Proposals
Usage Analytics
Billing Automation
Explore Location Benefits
Fleet Managers
Complete fleet oversight and optimization
Key Benefits
→
Access to private charging infrastructure: Get access to private charging infrastructure from our network
→
Cost Control: Detailed analytics on energy consumption, charging costs, and operational efficiency
→
Pricing proposals for frequent visitors: Contractual pricing agreements for even better prices per kWh against a fixed minimum capacity
→
Automated Billing: Seamless payment processing and invoice generation
Platform Features
Fleet Dashboard
Mobile Driver App
Cost Analytics
Pricing Proposals
Reporting Tools
Billing Automation
Explore Carrier Benefits

Why ChargeNet?
We bring locations with private charging infrastructure and EV fleets together on one platform.
3.8Bn tonne CO₂
Average truck pollution of 7.0 g/mi pollution (NOx), 100x more than a gasoline car
18%
of all emissions in the EU comes from road freight transport
80%
Fuel costs are rising and becoming more volatile
80%
Fossil fuel trucks are cheapest to buy, but have higher maintenance and running costs during their life-cycle.
What ChargeNet Does for You
We link fleets of EV trucks to nearby locations with private charging infrastructure on their destination.
Reduce charging costs
Reduce up to 60% of your charging costs compared to roaming or public charging.
One Platform
Work with an unlimited number of partners, all on one platform for your whole supply chain.
Control & Flexibility
Fully adaptable to your wishes on location and partner level, as each relation is unique.
Easy to Use
Our platform is uniquely developed to collaborate in the 3PL road transport relationship.
Private access
Get access to privately-owned charging locations that are part of the ChargeNet network.
Security by Design
We apply the latest cybersecurity standards in our product development to minimise risk to your operations.
Learn More About Our Platform
